metrics.label: Total Pixels
metrics.description: Pixels evaluated (whole mask, or the AOI subset when an AOI is supplied).

metrics.label: Vegetation Coverage
metrics.description: Vegetation pixels as a percentage of the evaluated area.

metrics.label: Vegetation Area
metrics.description: Vegetated ground area; null when no ground sample distance is available.

metrics.label: Evaluated Area
metrics.description: Total evaluated ground area; null when no ground sample distance is available.

metrics.label: Coverage Classification
metrics.description: Coverage class derived from the configured low and medium limits: low, medium or high.

metrics.label: Ground Sample Distance
metrics.description: Ground sample distance used for the area metrics; null when it could not be derived.

metrics.label: Zonation Cells
metrics.description: Number of grid cells in the zonation artifact.

metrics.label: Plots Analysed
metrics.description: Number of plots evaluated from the plots parameter (0 when none were supplied).

metrics.label: Average Plot Coverage
metrics.description: Mean coverage across analysed plots; null when no plots were supplied.

metrics.label: Highest Coverage Plot
metrics.description: Plot id with the highest coverage; null when no plots were supplied.

metrics.label: Lowest Coverage Plot
metrics.description: Plot id with the lowest coverage; null when no plots were supplied.
